title: canofac: Canonical Factorisation for Multiblock Data (R and Python)
description: Exploratory multiblock methods written in the canonical factorisation X_k = U D_k V_k' (Bougeard et al., 2024): a family of criteria indexed by a power q applied to the pseudo-singular values (MAXBET, CPCA, MCOA, CCSWA/ComDim/ACCPS, INDORT, STATIS, multiple factor analysis), trajectories of the blocks as q varies, and an exact leave-one-block-out (LOBO) permutation test with exact permutation moments and a gamma approximation. R package and Python package with the same functions, labels (English and French) and random number generator.
